TEXT: A few days have passed within the blink of an eye ever since I started my job as an assistant.
During that time, I've noticed all sorts of things.
Friends have more surprising sides than I initially thought.
Kuroneko's ability to concentrate is really good. How many hours can she draw continuously?
If it was me, it would definitely be impossible to concentrate like that... is what I used to think in the past...
I've been working together with Kuroneko, haven't I? I'm being inspired by her.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Kyousuke～, could you help me wash the dishes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Mom, I'm going to the usual place, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Can't you help me just for a bit? It won't take more than five minutes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If it doesn't take that long, you should do it yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: But, it seems like you have a lot of free time on your hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Tch, guess there's no other choice...
I should be a good son once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Just washing them will do, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Yeah, I'm counting on you.
All right, then I'll quickly get this over with.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh, you even wiped all the dishes? Thanks!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm, well, if it's just this much...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Hmm-hmm, Mom is really happy that you've become this nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uh... well, it's just this little bit...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: There there. Then I'm counting on you next time as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey...!
However, well... if this little deed makes her this happy, I guess it's not that bad after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I guess it's fine once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: I see. Thank you, Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Come to think of it, haven't you been acting a little strange recently?
Guh... well, although I'm aware of that too...
However, I don't think it'll be good telling my own mother about it. It just feels a little embarrassing... or rather, I'll definitely be teased by her?
Mom and Dad are different, it'll certainly spread uncontrollably once I tell her, and I can't imagine the results...
Against one's mother, it's not like I'll give her material to tease me about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I won't continue helping you if you keep trying to flatter me.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: My my, I'm not doing such things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's about time anyway, I have to go already!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: ...Really. Okay okay, Take care. Say hi to your girlfriend for me～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Like I said, she's not my girlfriend...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It seems I have a really hardworking kouhai.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Uh huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I thought of helping her out. That's why I felt like I need to be hardworking too.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Hmm～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That was a rather lacking response...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So then, I was thinking "Since I have nothing to do, what can I do?".

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Ah, is that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why are you so surprised?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: That's because I feel that Kyousuke is already doing 【the things that should be done】.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: It seems that you've been rather happy recently, aren't you?  It looks like you're moving towards an goal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Is that so?
It feels a little embarrassing when she puts it like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: That child, I don't think she's just a kouhai to you, is she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What are you saying all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Don't underestimate your mother's eyes, okay? I can see through everything about you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Guh... I-I'm running late! I'm going out!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh my, oh my, he ran away...
I did notice it a bit when I helped in the creation of that game last time... But this time, I was more involved in the process...? Compared to last time, I
could really feel it this time.
